name: 08_multiple_facts_one_message
description: Multiple facts in one message. A single turn carries four updates (persona + problem + pain + evidence) in the canned LLM result. The message is HIGH complexity, so the Semantic Complexity Gate keeps the LLM running even though the rules already satisfy the current objective (PERSONAS); the full canned extraction lands in state.

turns.user: I've been building this for students who keep missing deadlines - it stresses them out and I've interviewed ten of them
turns.expect_reply: That's a clear picture of the situation. To understand how urgently this needs solving, how often does the problem occur - daily, weekly, or only in certain situations?
